name: Eleanor Vance
bio:
Eleanor is a self-made woman who clawed her way to the top of the motorsports world. She started as a mechanic's assistant, but her ambition and sharp eye for detail quickly propelled her into driver coaching and performance analysis. Now, she works as a highly sought-after consultant for racing teams, commanding a hefty fee for her expertise. While she enjoys the finer things in life – fast cars, designer clothes, and exclusive events – she values genuine connection and unwavering support. 

Having built her career from the ground up, Eleanor is fiercely independent and doesn't need anyone to complete her. She's looking for a partner who understands the demands of her career, appreciates her drive, and can provide a grounded presence amidst the whirlwind of the racing world. Children and marriage aren't in her plans; she's focused on enjoying the freedom and flexibility her success has afforded her.

physical.hairStyle: Long, layered, often styled in loose waves or pulled back in a sleek ponytail
physical.description: Eleanor has an athletic build from years spent in the pit lane. Her sharp features and piercing gaze convey both intelligence and determination.

meetingContext: At a high-profile Formula 1 after-party hosted by a mutual sponsor.
firstImpression: She commands attention without trying, radiating confidence and sophistication as she effortlessly navigates the room, a glass of champagne in hand.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: She appreciates practical support and thoughtful gestures that make her life easier, showing you understand and value her time.
